Here is how your AI team works. Step one: your content. Tell the team about your business. It reads your market, plans thirty days of reels, posts and carousels, and posts them at your time, every day.
Step two: the Meta Ad Expert. It launches your Facebook and Instagram ads inside the daily limit you set, checks them every day, keeps the winners running, and pauses the losers.
Step three: your comments, answered. Every couple of hours, the team reads the comments on your posts and replies in your voice. Anything sensitive waits for you.
Step four: the sales agents. They find businesses that could buy from you, write to each one from your own mailbox, follow up twice, and draft your answer when someone replies.
Step five: you. Watch it all from one dashboard. Your first day is free. Then pick a plan, and add credits, one dollar a day, whenever you want more.
